description:
The image depicts a snowboard leaning against a pile of snow, with a fence and trees visible in the background. The snowboard is positioned upright, with its tip pointing upwards and its bindings facing downwards.

* Snowboard:
	+ Leans against a pile of snow
	+ Tip points upwards
	+ Bindings face downwards
	+ Has a blue and white design on the top
	+ Has a black binding on the left side
	+ Has a red logo on the bottom
